author: GamingBolt
description:
Infinite Rush understands the Hot Wheels fantasy. It isn’t about precise racing or perfect cornering, and while its easiest difficulties might seem too forgiving for adults, the sheer speed and spectacle of throwing little plastic cars around at unreasonable velocities awakened a childlike glee in me. 

I genuinely didn’t care if I won or lost, I just wanted debris.
title: Hot Wheels: Infinite Rush Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
Fuse Games and the connections it already has to the Burnout franchise are already well known, but Star Wars: Galactic Racer shares so much DNA with Criterion’s popular arcade racer franchise that we felt it merits a discussion. 

That doesn’t mean that we’re calling this one a clone with no soul of its own, though. Indeed, we’re suggesting the opposite, as we dive into what it’s trying to do differently, and how the fresh and the familiar soon blend into the scenery that’s speeding by as you tear across treacherous tracks.

In the process, we think Galactic Racer is going to scratch a very specific itch. Join us as we take you on a speedy drive through a windy set of roads that represent our thoughts on this one.
title: Star Wars Galactic Racer Could Be the BURNOUT Successor We Never Expected

author: GamingBolt
description:
By now, you've probably heard the news: PlayStation is stepping away from Physint. Announced in January 2024, the “next-generation action espionage game” would mark Kojima Productions' return to the genre after Metal Gear Solid 5: The Phantom Pain. Details were sparse at the time, but Kojima noted that Sony also did movies, and that this would be a “movie” at the same time. 

The tease of Sony Pictures Motion Picture Group and Columbia Pictures perhaps hinted at some live-action component, if not a companion film. After all, if the man who's accomplished almost everything in the industry has ever wanted anything, it's to direct a movie.
title: Physint - What The Hell Is Even Going On?
